summary.headline: Cathayan Duodecimal and Sexagesimal Cycles
summary.text: Discussion of Cathayan, Indian, and Turkestani calendrical cycles, including the twelve-part duodecimal cycle, the ten-part Cathayan cycle, and their combination into a sixty-part sexagesimal cycle used to count years and days. A table gives cycle values in years, days, hours, and minutes, followed by names in the Cathayan language and a reference to the commentary on the Zij.
